character: A lean long-limbed man of forty-five, tawny fur greying at the muzzle, one ear torn to a notch, rope-burn scars across both palms. A wide grin.
wardrobe: A striped sash wound tight over a sleeveless leather jerkin, bare arms, a wooden belaying pin through the sash, nine knotted cords at his belt.

full.framing: Full body portrait, front view. Standing easily on the rail of a black-hulled ship, one hand on a rope.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer.

scene.framing: Knocking the head off a barrel with a belaying pin on a crowded pirate ship's deck, the crew cheering, cannon smoke drifting.
